# Field AdministratePermission

Enable user to administrate all project permissions, Unspecified must be left for folder and document permissions.

###### Namespace: TopSolid.Kernel.Automating

###### Assembly: TopSolid.Kernel.Automating.dll

##### Syntax

```
[DataMember]
public PdmSecurityPermission AdministratePermission
```

##### Returns

|  Type |  Description |  
| --- | --- | 
   
|  PdmSecurityPermission |  Enable user to administrate all project permissions, must be left for folder and document permissions. |
